name: MPII Human Pose Dataset
description: A standard state-of-the-art benchmark for articulated human pose estimation evaluation. Comprises roughly 25,000 images containing over 40,000 annotated people, collected from everyday human activities extracted from YouTube videos. Features high variation in body orientation, scale, occlusion, and background clutter, with manual annotations of 16 body joint locations, head orientation, 3D torso direction, and activity labels covering 410 distinct human actions.
